text: This report responds to City Council's direction through Item MM2.15 to investigate the feasibility of providing a New Year's Eve grace period for "Park in Permit Parking Location without a Valid Permit" violations between 10:00 p.m. on December 31 and 10:00 a.m. on January 1. Staff conducted this feasibility study by completing a jurisdictional scan and analyzing the policy proposal in the following areas: - required amendments to City By-laws; - impact on the Residential On-Street Parking Program; - impact on Parking Tags Enforcement and Operations; and - impact on the City's Administrative Penalty System (APS) for parking violations. A New Year's Eve grace period, as outlined in Item MM2.15, requires an amendment to the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925 (Permit Parking), allowing for the elimination of the Permit Parking By-law during the designated time period.
